abstract: The identification of atypical testicular germ cells is often difficult by by routine histologic examination. By immunohistochemical detection of placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and by periodic acid Schiff staining of glycogen, atypical germ cells were easily identified in testicular samples. Forty-one fetal and adult testes were used for a preliminary study, and 121 testes from infants and adults with either cryptorchidism or germ cell tumors were studied for the presence of atypical germ cells. Two types of clear germ cells were differentiated histochemically, and one with PLAP-positive cell surfaces and glycogen-rich cytoplasm was considered to be atypical. The alkaline phosphatase of atypical germ cells appeared to be similar to that found in a few germ cells of early fetal testes. The atypical germ cells seemed to be multi-potential malignant cells capable of developing not only into seminoma but also into other germ cell tumors. Only in yolk sac tumor of infants were the atypical germ cells absent from tumor-adjacent seminiferous tubules.
abstract_ja: 精巣の異型胚細胞は、通常の組織学的検査では同定が困難なことが多い。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の免疫組織化学的検出と、グリコーゲンのPAS染色により、精巣検体中の異型胚細胞を容易に同定できた。予備検討として胎児および成人の精巣41例を用いた。停留精巣または胚細胞腫瘍を有する乳児および成人の精巣121例について、異型胚細胞の有無を検討した。組織化学的に2種類の明瞭な胚細胞が区別され、PLAP陽性の細胞表面とグリコーゲンに富む細胞質を持つものを異型と判定した。異型胚細胞のアルカリホスファターゼは、初期胎児精巣の少数の胚細胞に見られるものと類似していた。異型胚細胞は多能性の悪性細胞であり、セミノーマだけでなく他の胚細胞腫瘍へも発達しうると考えられた。乳児の卵黄嚢腫瘍においてのみ、腫瘍に隣接する精細管に異型胚細胞は認められなかった。
